public_rationale: Contemporaneous evaluations found recurring failures beyond familiar training domains across several kinds of visual data. This supports the ordinary reading that distribution shift remained a major weakness. The same research found useful improvements through adaptation, so the evidence supports persistent difficulty, not universal failure or impossibility.
limitations: The decisive study concerns multimodal language models rather than every neural architecture.
The decisive source is a preprint.
The evidence does not establish that distribution shift was the single greatest weakness.
